2608.23563.title: EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings
2608.23563.paper_summary: Road traffic injuries remain a major challenge in low- and middle-income countries, where proactive road safety auditing is limited by incomplete crash records, shortages of qualified auditors, and the high cost of large-scale field inspections. To address this problem, we propose Expert-Grounded Distillation (EGD), a novel artificial intelligence framework that transfers institutional road safety expertise into a compact vision-language model for scalable visual road safety auditing. The key innovation is a quantified expert-grounding stage in which the teacher vision-language model is calibrated against authoritative field audits. Large-scale annotation is permitted only after the teacher reaches substantial agreement with expert risk assessments (Cohen's kappa = 0.74). The calibrated teacher then generates structured supervision that is distilled into an 8-billion-parameter student vision-language model using Low-Rank Adaptation and a single leakage-free prompt. We also introduce Bangladesh Road Safety Audit (BD-ARSA), the first open, expert-grounded Bangladeshi visual road safety audit dataset containing 21,947 image-audit records with near-national coverage, and Expert-Grounded Road Safety Auditor (EG-ARSA), the first vision-language model developed specifically for this task. Experimental results show that grounded fine-tuning substantially improves ordinal risk assessment over the zero-shot baseline, while blind expert evaluation demonstrates that the compact student outperforms both its 31 billion-parameter teacher and Gemini-2.5-Flash. These findings demonstrate that EGD provides an effective and scalable engineering solution for proactive road safety auditing in resource-constrained environments.
2608.23563.paper_summary_zh: 道路交通傷害在低收入和中等收入國家仍然是一個主要挑戰，主動的道路安全審核受到不完整的事故記錄、合格審核員的短缺以及大規模現場檢查的高成本的限制。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了專家基礎蒸餾（EGD），這是一個新穎的人工智慧框架，將機構道路安全專業知識轉移到一個緊湊的視覺-語言模型中，以進行可擴展的視覺道路安全審核。關鍵創新是一個量化的專家基礎階段，在這一階段，教師視覺-語言模型根據權威的現場審核進行校準。只有在教師與專家風險評估達成實質性一致後（Cohen's kappa = 0.74），才允許進行大規模標註。然後，經過校準的教師生成結構化的監督，這些監督通過低秩適應和單一無洩漏提示被蒸餾到一個擁有80億參數的學生視覺-語言模型中。我們還介紹了孟加拉國道路安全審核（BD-ARSA），這是第一個開放的、專家基礎的孟加拉國視覺道路安全審核數據集，包含21,947個圖像審核記錄，幾乎覆蓋全國，以及專家基礎道路安全審核員（EG-ARSA），這是專門為此任務開發的第一個視覺-語言模型。實驗結果顯示，基於基礎的微調顯著改善了序數風險評估，相較於零樣本基線，盲目專家評估顯示緊湊的學生模型超越了其310億參數的教師模型和Gemini-2.5-Flash。這些發現表明，EGD為資源有限環境中的主動道路安全審核提供了一個有效且可擴展的工程解決方案。
